## Purpose

Inspect selection feature flags, the active omission promotion and the latest recorded artifact digests.

## When a playbook uses it

An operator diagnosing why Jev may add tests but cannot omit static impact, or preparing an evaluated identity for local promotion.

## How it works internally

The handler applies project operator scope, reads the live configuration and active promotion, and extracts digests from the newest project selection. See [`test_selection_commands.py`](../../../src/commands/test_selection_commands.py) and [`service.py`](../../../src/test_selection/service.py).

## Side effects and persistence

Read-only. `latest_digests` is null before the first selection and describes the latest record, not necessarily the current workspace.

## Failure modes and diagnostics

`out_of_scope` refuses ordinary workers and cross-project supervisors. A promotion applies only when all identity fields match; this command neither enables enforcement nor promotes automatically.

## Example step

Command-step payload (promotion/revocation examples require a local operator context):

```json
{"command": "test_selection_policy_show", "args": {"project_id": "agent-queue"}}
```
